Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Hello, children. Welcome to the Macabre Book Mobile. What is your pleasure tonight? How about a fright? Well, you are in luck, because I have three stories that are guaranteed to make you scream with delight. Mwa...Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! (a hand tickles him with a feather) Stop it! (takes the feather) Enough with the feather, Renfield. We talked about this. Now, knock it off and go and stand over there by the Chifferobe. And stay out of those olives. I'm saving them. (zoom in) For company. Mwa...Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, excuse me?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: What?

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: Can I get a free-range organic grilled cheese slider?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: This isn't a food truck, you baboon. It's a Macabre Book Mobile.

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: (takes out phone and leaves) Yeah, I'm totally giving you a bad review.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: (shakes fist) May the ancient moths of Sumeria feast upon your skinny jeans! (phone buzzes) One star? Man, that burns. N-Now where was I? Oh, yes. The first story in our (blood red title appears on screen) Terrifying Tri-State Trilogy of Terror... (notices the title on screen) Oh, for crying out loud! (Takes out a squeegee and wipes off the words, line by line.) Sorry about that. Now where were we?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Chapter one. A teenage girl chats idly (Crossfade to the Flynn-Fletcher house.) to her friend on the phone alone in her room as a storm rages outside. (A lightning flashes on background) Little does she know what evil awaits her as she discovers how dangerous careless words can be.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) No, Stacy, I have the whole place to myself. Mom and Dad are at the movies, and the boys are playing ping pong over at Buford's. Oh, so listen to this weird book I've been readin'. "If one repeats this incantation in the presence of a doll, then alive it shall be!" Ha ha! But check this out

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me? I'm just makin' a snack. Oh I just thought I'd have, you know, somethin' healthy. What? Oh, okay, you caught me. Donuts and cheesy popcorn. (The Ducky Momo doll peers behind the door. The door handle jiggles. Cut to outside as the doll attempts to open the door. The doll reaches into its stuffing and takes out a credit card and slides it through the door. Cut to Candace getting a glass of water.) Yeah, Jeremy was so great, he took us out for mani-pedis. (The door opens.) Is someone there? Oh, the storm just blew the door open. Yeah, I know. Creepy. (The Ducky Momo doll attempts to walk between Candace's legs. Candace closes the door with her leg, slamming it on the doll.) Anyway, since Jeremy's mom is a regular at the mani-pedi place, we got special treatment. Yeah, they served us sparkling apple juice and finger sandwiches and made fun of us in Thai. It was all so classy. What can I say? (closes the fridge door with her foot) I love a well-groomed foot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is someone there? (gasps and dials her phone) Stacy, I know you're gonna think this is crazy, but I honestly think something is in the room with me. Have you ever been in a situation where your whole body, like, senses a presence? Like, you can't see it, but it's, like...it's, like, right next to...you? (Zoom out to reveal the Ducky Momo doll on the arm of the couch. The doll quacks and stretches his arms out. Candace screams and runs off.) Upstairs! The only logical escape! (Candace runs upstairs but gets her ankle caught in a curtain. The doll approaches the stairs quacking. Candace screams and bites the curtain off. The doll climbs up the stairs. Candace frees herself from the curtain, hides behind a wall and dials her phone.) Stacy, you gotta help me! The spell from that weird book worked! Ducky Momo is alive and he's trying to get me!! No, he's downstairs. He—Would you stop laughing? Yes, you are! I can hear the milk shooting out of your nose! (She looks behind her and sees the doll and yells, dropping her phone.) My phone! (The phone lands by the doll's webbed feet. It ends the call.) Back! Stay back! Ah! (Takes down a picture) Stay away from me! (Takes down a poster and crumples it up.) You stay away! I'm serious! Uh! (She slides a table across the hall.) Oh, come on! (The doll sees the crumpled poster on the floor and walks around it.) No! He's unstoppable! (Cut to Candace pulling on her bedroom door handle.) Come on! Open! Open! Open! Oh, yeah. It's an innie. (Pushes the door open and pants.) Keep it together, Candace, think! Think think think! Block the door! Block the door! (She blocks the door with everything but the kitchen sink. She then pulls up the doll and screams and hides under her bed.) I didn't really mean to wish you to life! I was just goofing around! I don't understand! What do you want?! (The doll jumps on the bed, reaches out his arms and quacks.) Huh? It almost looks like you want a...a hug. (The doll jumps up and down excitedly.) Seriously? You just want a hug? Well, okay. (Hugs the doll.) But I don't get it. If the incantation made you alive, then the moonlight should've made you evil. (The doll shakes his head quacking and points out the window.) What? What? Oh, the moon was behind the clouds, so you're not evil. (The clouds uncover the full moon shining on Mr. Miggins, who comes to life and roars evilly.) But now Mr. Miggins is!! AAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Ah, you have returned for more. (Throws away the olive.) Our second story starts upon a dark and stormy night, where a platypus will soon show an evil scientist that every wish has a twist and the wisher might not wish for what he wished. Mwa..Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, if I wasn't so hungry, this would be horrifying. (Perry is surrounded by several strands of shredded cheeses.) Well, you may have shredded it, but you haven't stopped it! (The shreds all come at Perry. Doofenshmirtz laughs evilly. Perry then kneels down and begins eating the shreds.) Oh, I see. I don't know how I forgot that cheese was edible. By the way, I believe you're over the five-second rule there, Perry the Platy— (Perry flings himself at Doofenshmirtz's head.) Ow! Well, I hope you didn't leave room for crackers! Crackers, go get 'im! (A cabinet opens and several boxes of oyster crackers fly out.) Why do I have six boxes of oyster crackers? Must've been on sale. (The boxes open and fire crackers at Perry.) Eh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus, but let's see how you do against the hard stuff. Parmesan, give 'im a taste of your crystalline texture.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, so you beat up a bunch of snacks. Big deal. But you forget, Perry the Platypus, I still have one wish left and I've learned from my past two mistakes. I'm going to do this one right! You know what it is I want, Perry the Platypus? I want to be the biggest ruler of the...What? Oh, you're right. I say "ruler" and I could end up being like a big wooden yardstick or something. G-Good catch. Good, good catch, Perry the Platypus. Let me rephrase that. I want to be, specifically, the monarch of—No, no. No, you're right, that's a butterfly. Well, how about, the super-inten—no, no. Wait, I-I know! I wish to be the head of the Tri-State Area! Oh, shoot, I just heard that!

Name: Giant Floating Doofy Head
Dialog: Yep. Yep, I'm a head. A big old head, Perry the Platypus. That's what I wished for. (Perry leaves.) Where're you goin'? So what? I don't need your help! That's right! Just walk away,(Agent P walks to the door. He opens the door and leaves with a smiling) Perry the Platypus! Oh, you're giving me the smirk face! Nice, fine! Maybe I like being a giant head, huh? Uh, oh. Uh, I have to itch my nose! Oh, no! I can't...Ah...AH-CHOO! (The Giant Floating Doofy Head's sneeze causes him to crash into the computer. An inexplicable cat screech is heard.) Ow! Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and you, too, you Giant inexplicable Floating Baby Head!! (Thunder and lightning) Ah, knock it off!

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: At dot dot dot, funny words, add the picture and...(notices the viewer) Ah! Back from the commercial, are we? (picks up the book) Shall I continue, hmm? The final grim installment in our Terrifying Tri-State Trilogy of Terror takes place in an unassuming suburban backyard, where five happy campers and their platypus discover they may not know what they're going to do today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Suddenly, from out of the shadows, (making a shadow puppet) the zombie bunny rabbit appeared and then he...ate up all the marshmallows!!! Numnumnumnumnumnunmnum!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Remember, those marshmallows are for everyone!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Zombie bunny don't care!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, it's my turn to tell a scary story.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! What's it gonna be? Suspense, stalker, horror, action adventure, or my personal favorite, the campy costume alien teen romance dramedy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, let's see what's in this weird book. "Make a Doll Come Alive," "How to Get Three Wishes," "Giant Floating Rest of Baby"...Hey, check it out! It says here you have to be careful not to spill grape juice on a platypus, or it will make an evil platypus clone. I'm not really sure why anyone would—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Keep readin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, stop! (dries Perry off with a towel and bundles him like a baby) Aw, poor little guy. Buford, you shouldn't pour anything on a platypus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) I just wanted to see what would happen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (unbundling Perry) Well, he's dry, but now he's purple. (The purple stain jumps off of Perry and creates a purple platypus.) Whoa!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Cool! It actually worked! (sticking a finger out) Who's my little platypus clone? (The clone snarls at Buford.) What was that all about?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What part of "evil clone" are you not getting?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Obviously, the "evil" part.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I say we take off and nuke the entire site from orbit! It's the only way to be sure.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Cheese and crackers!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no! Look! They are using our grape juice box to make more!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, this is such a Halloween thing to happen in the middle of summer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are we gonna do, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have to contain these duplicating evil platypuses somehow. (paces) Uh, we could build a vacuum that attracts only platypus fur. No, no, then Perry would be in danger. Uh, maybe an alpha-ray grid to...No, no...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (aside to Baljeet) I can smell his brain workin'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, sure, blame it on Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I dunno, gang. I'm kinda stumped on this one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fear not! I know someone who can help us! Follow me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it, Baljeet. Where are we going?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whenever I need counsel on a problem, I go to my life coach.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Life coach?! I am so hurt!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (ringing the doorbell) Buford, this man is the embodiment of pure thought and wisdom.

Name: Cowboy
Dialog: Well, well, if'n it ain't Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Everyone, this is Rusty Britches. Rusty, this is everyone.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, I'm right pleased to meet you kids!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wha...Howdy?

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, don't just stand there with your hair on your head and your socks tucked into your boots, come on in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you for the lemonade, Rusty.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: You're surely welcome! Now, what can I do you for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If I may, Mr. Britches, the city's been overrun by evil platypuses and we can't figure out how to get rid of 'em.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, that's a real beehive in your well water. Lemme get my thinkin' bench. (He walks off and a loud creaking noise is heard. He comes back and drags a bench across the floor. He puts one boot on it.) Well, it's like old Pap used to say, "When your horse starts drawin' a bath instead of a wagon, it's time to change the welcome mat."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Does anyone else get the feelin' we're really takin' our time with this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, Rusty, we really appreciate your colloquial prairie wisdom, but I think we have to move along before things get worse out there.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, I reckon you know best. It was right fine to meet you... (His foot accidentally tips the lemonade glass on the bench over.) Aw, cheese and crackers! (He gets out a small brush and cleans up the spilt lemonade.) This is supposed to be for cleanin' boats, but sometimes, ya gotta wash with the wrong brush to get a colt to the chaparral.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wash? Brush?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Chaparral?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! You're a genius, Mr. Britches!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Aw, shucks. I'm just a simple cowboy life coach.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So since the evil platypuses are made out of grape juice stains and dark magic, these high-powered bubble washers oughta do the trick. Okay, suds up, people! We're goin' platy-scrubbin'!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: (picking up a guitar) Hey, Phineas, how 'bout some good ol', down-home, granny-slappin', platy-scrubbin' musical accompaniment?

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, hey hey hey! What the heck, man?! Ya bringin' us down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's really...a good song, but, uh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Maybe you could play something a little more, you know, up-tempo.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Oh, right! Gotcha!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Rusty!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: G'wan without me! It's as I always say, "You gotta..." (Before he can finish his saying, the platypuses pinch his nose and pull him down.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This doesn't look too good, Ferb! Everybody retreat to that factory!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no, guys! This is a grape juice box factory!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How terrifyingly specific!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Run!!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There's too many of them! PHINEAS!! (The platypuses attack Isabella and Baljeet.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella!! (Phineas runs back, but gets attacked.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gettin' tired of runnin' from these jerks! (The platypuses attack Buford and Ferb.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) And so our heroes were ripped to shreds...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...and left to die.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait a minute! That was a pretty grim ending, don't you think?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Talk about your unlightful endings.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He means "delightful" and he means the opposite of that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, okay. I'll give you the Hollywood ending.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have a plan. Everyone keep your eye out for the sprinkler system supply housing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There it is!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you, Baljeet, and Buford hold them back while we get the soap into the sprinkler system!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You'd better hurry, Phineas!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There are too many of them!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no! The manual override is way up there! There's no way I can reach it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, guys, I'm out!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am out, too!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What are we gonna do?!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Yeehaw!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look, everyone! It's Baljeet's cowboy life coach!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: On a unicorn! Straining all credulity, he has come to save us!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Soap's on, little tykes!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Rusty, you did it! They are all melting away!

Name: Grape Juice Cop
Dialog: You've saved my factory!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look, everyone! It is Officer Concord the Juice Time Juice Box Flavor Cop!

Name: Officer Concord
Dialog: Well done, everyone! Let's dance!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa...whoa...whoa.....whoa!! Totally unbelievable!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Which part? The unicorn or Officer Concord the Juice Time Juice Box Flavor Cop?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah. The cowboy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You do not believe in cowboys?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Have you ever seen one in real life?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: So, you see, if I had a Macabre Book Mobile, those are the kinds of things that could happen.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: I'm gonna be blunt, Mr. Macabre...

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: It's Macabré.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: Mr. Macabré, I'm not gonna give ya a loan to buy a Macabre Book Mobile.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: And why not?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: You have no detailed records of assets, no inventory, nothing you could use as collateral. Your stories don't even make sense! It's a bad business proposition.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: What if I were to say, "Please"?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: That's not gonna work.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Please?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: Get out!

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: A cherry, huh? (Sighs) Okay, but this is the last loan I am giving you.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: OW! (trips and falls over) Dangit!! Ah! I'm alright! You go ahead and read the credits. I...I'll just wait down here. (beat) Kinda nice down here, actually. There's a...There's a dandelion. It's all puffy and ready to go. Here ya go. (Blows, and the dandelion seeds float away.) Logo oughta be comin' up any minute. (Cue the logo.) There it is!
